hidden_risks: Actual wattage output and charging efficiency under load
Presence of micro-cracks in the solar cells
Condition of the rear junction box, diodes, and attached cables
Total lifespan/degeneration level of the silicon wafers
response.best_proof: A clear photograph of the rear specification label showing wattage/voltage ratings and a test reading using a multimeter under sunlight.
response.failure_mode: Assuming the panel functions properly and delivers its rated electrical output based solely on a front-facing photo without testing or inspecting the rear specs label.
